page: Google Cloud Platform c2d-standard-56 is a compute-optimized instance powered by a dedicated 28-core AMD EPYC 7B13 processor delivering 56 virtual CPUs via simultaneous multithreading. It features 224 GB of system memory, providing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the processor features standard instruction set extensions such as AVX, FMA, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI hardware acceleration, alongside 32 MB of L3 cache, though it lacks AVX-512 and AMX extensions.

In performance testing, the instance demonstrates high parallel processing capacity, scoring in the top quartile for stress-ng multi-core tests, PassMark CPU evaluation, and Geekbench multi-core workloads. Memory subsystem efficiency is notable, achieving a top-tier score in PassMark memory benchmarks alongside high cached memory bandwidth. High-concurrency operations excel, as evidenced by strong throughput in Redis SET operations and robust software compilation speeds using Clang.

Resource efficiency is derived from its high core density and dedicated CPU allocation without attached GPU overhead or bundled local storage drive costs. While memory bandwidth for uncached large blocks sits at average levels, CPU-bound tasks and small-model LLM text generation perform in upper performance tiers. The system is well-suited for high-throughput software build systems, database engines, parallel batch processing, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
description: Google Cloud Platform c2d-standard-56 is a compute-optimized instance featuring 56 dedicated vCPUs derived from 28 physical cores on an AMD EPYC 7B13 processor, paired with 224 GB of RAM. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, it includes vector and cryptographic acceleration through AVX, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI instructions. Multi-core performance is strong across synthetic benchmarks like stress-ng, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench, complimented by top-tier PassMark memory subsystem scores and high cached memory throughput. Without attached GPUs or local NVMe storage, the configuration avoids idle accelerator overhead while delivering high efficiency for multi-threaded tasks. Benchmark results confirm strong capabilities in Redis key-value operations, software compilation, and CPU-driven LLM inference generation. This hardware profile provides an optimal foundation for compute-heavy enterprise workloads, database operations, parallel build pipelines, and data analytics tasks.
